beats.headline: A goat on a sponsor's patch
beats.text: A gold box from the Plenty holds a jacket patch: black denim, a gray goat head. Crawler Carl has seen the symbol tattooed on the back of Prepotente's hand and had assumed it belonged to a deity. My description: the Midnight Epicure, the Caprid Who Devours the Sky. Eat your dinner, or he comes to eat it for you, and then every child in the home. The symbol, really a racist caricature of an adult caprid, became a ward against all night evils. Protection against Vampirism and Lycanthropy. Mordecai says sew it on at once.

beats.headline: An address on the dial
beats.text: Katia asks in chat how to tune the thing, since it is just lights. Prepotente explains, out loud, that the mechanism is quite simple. First turn off automatic mode, or Crawler Carl lands at the Emberus temple, Katia at Eileithyia's, and Prepotente himself at the Epicure. Integers here. But they need the address to dial in, and Carl calls out the numbers Rosetta gives him.

beats.headline: Fallen into a goat's hands
beats.text: An update to Crawler Carl's quest to find out who killed Emberus's son. The memorial crystal of Apito has fallen from Crawler Osvaldo's hands and is now with Crawler Prepotente. Retrieve it from him before he cracks its secrets and gives them to the Epicure. Carl has no idea how the crystal moved from one to the other without a fight, and decides the conversation with the goat can wait until neither of them is so keyed up.

beats.headline: The goats panic on air
beats.text: A live broadcast with the caprid council of the Plenty goes badly. Something Crawler Carl says sets the goats braying, and they begin to cry out, one after another. The Epicure. We shall manifest the Epicure. The True Judgment; she has fulfilled her bargain. The great stampede comes. The beautiful place. Crawler Donut asks in chat whether the Midnight Epicure is the god Prepotente worships. It is, Carl says, and he wears its patch on his own jacket. Are they excited because they think the god is real now? Carl has no clue.

beats.headline: Prepotente explains his god
beats.text: Asked directly, Prepotente answers. The Midnight Epicure protects all prey animals by destroying all existence after unleashing everything consumed back into the galaxy. They who were eaten become the devourers. It began as a xenophobic tale told to non-caprid children when caprids first joined Syndicate culture, and grew into a symbol of hope and comfort for his kind. His sponsors gave him the ability to worship it in a benefactor box. The Epicure told him the memorial crystal was crucial, and sent him sobbing tirades when it was stolen.

beats.headline: Black dahlias on the float
beats.text: Parade. Behind Prepotente, atop the stair truck, stands a giant head of the Midnight Epicure made of black dahlias. The plan is Crawler Donut's: a stinging statement from the goat about the downtrodden rising to devour those who revel in their suffering, then Bianca burning away the flowers to show the skull beneath. Prepotente sings instead. In Crawler Carl's account the Epicure is a symbol of hope and of vengeance against the galaxy's predators, and the effigy of the Unwashed further down the float is the death that comes for everyone.

beats.headline: A formal complaint
beats.text: After the crash, Prepotente reports in: electrocuted, but fine. A deity pulled the memorial crystal right off his neck. He has filed a formal complaint with the Epicure. Jurgen, also fried, tells him he is lucky the god did not pull his head off. Crawler Carl's own worry is the crystal: if Prepotente has lost it, they have lost their protection from Scolopendra's attacks.
